content: Labour admits defeat in Wales Welsh First Minister Eluned Morgan arrived at the Ceredigion Penfro count expecting a grim set of results - multiple sources tell the BBC she is one of a number of Labour figures expected to lose her seat. Her deputy, Huw Irranca-Davies, has already accepted that Labour won't be in position "to actually form the next government". A small number of results have been announced already - with Plaid Cymru and Reform UK winning the most seats so far.
